    • /card

    Card Components for React & Next.js

    Find 422 versatile React card components built with Tailwind CSS, perfect for showcasing content elegantly in any Next.js application.

    • Stats cards with links

      by Ephraim Duncan

    • Course Design Cards

      by kristen17

    About card components

    This is a large collection of 834 card components for React, the container pattern for grouping related content. You'll find product cards, pricing cards, profile and testimonial cards, stat tiles, and media cards with images or video. Styles range from flat and bordered to elevated with shadows, plus hover and 3D-tilt variants. Whether you need a react card for a grid of items or a single feature callout, there's a layout here for it.

    Match the container to its content: use a media card for image-led items and a compact one for dense dashboards. Keep spacing consistent across a grid so everything lines up. Copy a card's TSX, run the shadcn CLI with its registry URL, or pull it through the Magic MCP in Cursor or Claude Code. They follow shadcn/ui conventions, use Tailwind, and drop into any Next.js project.
